Claim revision (seat judgement on dev report 7218033222): option A on both open questions.

- Premise measured: the managed refusal is 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` in the ADR-0112 envelope, but `createAuthClient.ts` `toAuthError` reads only the top-level `code` / `message`, so the code arrives nested under `error.error` and is dropped; the page shows `Auth request failed with status 409`. The producer-side fix (read the nested envelope) comes first, then the localized mapping.
- File surface (replaces the claim's line): `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts` (the `toAuthError` hunk only), `ui/packages/auth/src/ForgotPasswordForm.tsx` (an `errorMessages` prop), app-shell `signInRefusalMessages.ts` and the login / forgot-password pages that pass it, `ui/packages/i18n` locales en / zh-Hans / ja / es, `apps/console` `ResetPasswordPage.tsx` and `SetPasswordPage.tsx`, their tests, one changeset.
- Serial constraint against #37433 (draft, last touched 2026-11-26): it changes only the `updateUser` hunk of `createAuthClient.ts` and `types.ts`. This PR touches the `toAuthError` hunk and not `types.ts`; the two merge in either order. Whichever lands second re-runs its tests on the merged tree.
- Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default`, `effort: high`.
- Scope unchanged otherwise: the whole card, `Fixes #34171`. Option D (map a code-less 409 in the form) is not taken.
